name: real-partner-igug-together-metcon-20260726
description: IGUG 'however' partner metcon; flat top-level movements[] with a (together) Echo Bike (substituted from run). Regression guard: together movements must NOT be halved into a per-partner share; splittable rep movements still show the per-partner share.

workout.title: WOD
workout.rawText:
23/07/26
METCON (Long)
In pairs, I go you go (however):
For time:
400m run (together)
100 Alternating Kettlebell Swings @16/24kg
400m run (together)
100 Push-ups
400m run (together)
100 Toes to Bar
400m run (together)
100 Goblet Lunges @16/24kg
400 Double Unders / 800 Singles
< 35 minutes T.C. >
* You can change the order as you wish

Cash out - Core
2 sets:
30/30 sec side plank hold
50 Russian Twists (plate / Kettlebell)
